title: Form builder
empty: No fields yet. Choose a field type below.
label: Label
optionalFiles: Optional fields may be left empty. The minimum applies when files are attached.
requiredLabel: Enter a field label (up to 200 characters).
requiredOption: Enter a value and display text (up to 200 characters each).
minFilesError: Enter a whole minimum from 0 to 20 (at least 1 when required).
maxFilesError: Enter a whole maximum from 1 to 20, at least the minimum.
helpError: Help text must be at most 5,000 characters.
placeholderError: The placeholder must be at most 300 characters.
maxFields: A form can contain at most 100 fields.
